name: 3D clay icon
region: 3D illustration on the web, then Microsoft Fluent Emoji 3D
summary: Icons rendered in 3D with soft, matte, clay-like materials, large round corners and a soft shadow. They bring depth back after the flat years, but with toy-like simplicity and no real texture.

philosophy.core_thesis: After a decade of flat glyphs, an icon can have volume again if the forms stay simple, round and soft like a toy.
design_principles: Model each object from simple volumes with large fillets: a radius of 15–25% of the object size.
Use a matte or satin material with soft subsurface light; no hard gloss.
Light the object with one large soft key light from the top left and a fill light at 30–50%.
Use a three-quarter view from 15–30° above.
Use 3 to 6 saturated pastel hues per icon, with gentle gradients from the light.
Ship each icon as a PNG at 256 px or more, with a transparent ground.

grid.keylines: The object fits a circle of 224 px; the shadow may extend 8 px below the live area.

stroke.rule: No stroke. Edges come from light and the fillet, not from a line.

shape.primitives: Rounded boxes, spheres, cylinders and tori with fillets of 15–25% of the object size.
shape.optical_size: Below 64 px, swap to a flat or glyph version; the 3D form loses its read under 48 px.

colour.strategy: Saturated pastel hues with soft light gradients from the key light.

perspective_and_light.light: One large soft key light from the top left and a fill light at 30–50%; soft ambient occlusion in the creases.
perspective_and_light.shadow: A soft contact shadow under the object at 20–30% opacity, tinted with the main hue.

metaphor.typical: A house, a camera, a folder, a rocket, a gift and a chat bubble.
metaphor.treatment: Literal objects simplified into toy-like volumes.

emotion.target_response: Delight and warmth: the icon looks soft enough to pick up.

use_cases: landing page heroes and feature cards
consumer and fintech apps with a soft voice
avoid_when: The icon must work in one colour or at 24 px.
The UI is a dense professional tool.

modifiers.how: Keep the hues and the simple shapes; remove the volume, the light and the shadow.
Keep the 3D view; replace clay with real materials, sharper fillets and a glossy highlight.

sources.title: Claymorphism, as described in the Smashing Magazine article (2022)
